target_customer: Indian retail investors and traders, including affluent investors using options strategies
problem: Indians lack guidance on trading and money decisions; marketfeed teaches stock trading and offers screeners, advice and automated options strategies.
business_model: Subscription and advisory products for retail traders (SEBI-registered advice) in India
product_category: Retail trading education and advisory app

founders.name: Sharique Samsudheen
founders.background_notes: YC bio: teaching people in India how to trade stocks

founders.name: Sooraj Elamana
founders.background_notes: YC bio: building a community of financially independent individuals

competitors.name: Tickertape
competitors.what: Indian stock research and screener app

technical_complexity.rationale: Content, screeners and an app are standard; automated options strategies add some trading integration.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar retail trading apps and content products; education and advice are easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; sources show a large revenue decline in FY25.

market_need_then: India saw a surge of new retail traders around 2020 and 2021, but no dated source was opened to quantify it.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission language about fixing what is wrong with money

rebrands.why: Not stated; a KrASIA profile and a support site refer to fundfolio and marketfeed together

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand was found; founders aim to build a community but no evidence of viral spread.

outcome_analysis: marketfeed was a Bengaluru retail trading education and advice startup that took a small YC-linked seed in 2021 and shows no later disclosed round. Inc42 reports FY25 revenue of about 1.2 crore rupees against 14.6 crore in FY24, a drop of 91.6 percent, so the business appears to have shrunk sharply even though the company is listed as active, and the cause is not public.
notes: Company website was not fetched successfully (fetch tool rate limited). Seed amount: Seedtable says 125K USD and a KrASIA profile says INR 92 lakh (not opened); Inc42 says undisclosed. Seedtable is an aggregator. Competitor entries come from app listing aggregators with no dated source. Revenue figures are from Inc42 and unverified. HQ is stated as Kochi by one source and Bengaluru by another. Prior employers and education not found.
